public.text: 5 — I’d certainly consider buying it. I already buy ready-to-drink bottled gazpacho, and it’s a convenient, refreshing option when I don’t have the energy to prepare something. I’d compare the price and sodium content, but the format itself works well for me.

justification: She said she would certainly consider buying it and already buys ready-to-drink bottled gazpacho, finding it convenient and refreshing.
